platformUser.requires: Live terrascale user sign-in token; ES256 at+jwt; audience includes issuer; current auth epoch and live token/sign-in entries. Active MFA primary-only users refused. Organization, project, service and API-key tokens refused.

oauth_userinfo.requires: Issuer's valid access token; live user/current authentication epoch; active MFA primary-only users refused.

token_audiences.sign_in: Includes issuer and configured resource audiences; ID tokens are client-bound.
token_audiences.project_key_or_exchange: Resource audience; org_id/project_id/scope, optional database only for narrowed API keys. Lifetime at most 15 minutes; exchange no longer than remaining subject lifetime.

step_up.consume: ts-dashboard only; delete_account requires operation_receipt and returns 200 {operation_grant} only after final proof deadline check; create_pat forbids receipt and returns 204
step_up.proof_header: X-TerraScale-Step-Up-Proof; fresh single-use ts-auth proof for account deletion, API-key create/rotate and Projects.CreateClientAsync
step_up.deletion_receipt: Exact receipt PLUS X-TerraScale-Deletion-Authorization from successful dashboard consume or first auth deletion replace proof only for that account/epoch/state/fresh-bindings continuation for 15 days. Receipt alone reads status only; late rejection or lost acknowledgement never releases a grant
step_up.retry: Never retry consume or credential mutation automatically, including on lost responses

authorization: Producer rechecks ownership/membership/role; SDK never treats UI roles or local IDs as authority.
pagination: limit 1..100 (default 20), opaque after bound to same list; items/next; next null ends. IDs unchanged; key lists creation order, org/project/member lists id order.

errors.safe_metadata: StatusCode, admitted ErrorCode, RetryAfter only; unknown code, server descriptions and bodies omitted.

retry: No automatic retries for this integration surface; no stable mutation idempotency contract.
revocation: Revoking user access/refresh token ends sign-in in ts-auth. Key/role revocation prevents fresh scope issuance. Offline tokens persist until expiry; no immediate offline revocation claim.
handler_prerequisite: Caller-owned HttpClient must disable redirects and cookies. SDK DI does so; arbitrary handlers cannot be inspected. SDK never owns caller HttpClient disposal.
qualification: Source-derived contract and synthetic HTTP fakes only. Producer parity, exact package compatibility and live integration remain unproven. Token database narrowing via exchange is absent. Introspection endpoint is absent.

api_key_secret_format.one_time_display: Only creation/rotation returns key; listings/get return metadata.

invitations.token: tsi_ followed by 52 lowercase base32 characters; shown once and emailed by producer; never log or persist in dashboard
invitations.security: User sign-in bearer; verified invitee email must match for accept/decline; token alone is not authorization
invitations.roles: Organization admin creates/lists/revokes; owner required when inviting owner. Project admin can target/list project_id. Producer checks current authority.
invitations.rate_limit: Create only: 100 invitations per organization per hour; 429 rate_limited, no retry by SDK.

ownership_transfer: Owner nominates a current non-owner member for seven days. Starting a transfer replaces any pending offer and returns 201, not 409. Nominee confirms, becoming owner while initiating owner becomes admin. Owner or nominee cancels. A pending offer reads as 404 when absent/expired, when its initiating user is no longer an owner, or when its nominee is no longer a non-owner organization member (viewer/member/admin).
audit_events: Organization admin reads newest-first items/next; producer retains at least 90 days.
